canonical_serialization: UTF-8, LF, sorted object keys, two-space indentation, one terminal newline

freeze_policy.changes_after_first_producer: forbidden; create a new artifact revision and obtain independent review
freeze_policy.threshold_class: pre-producer governance thresholds; literature asymptotes remain separately identified

nonclaims: no full-domain V1, V2, or V3 certification
no finite-radius observer or detector response
no V3 science execution in V3.0

thresholds.domain: all V3.1 modes with max(|S_ref|,|S_test|)>=1e-12
thresholds.observable: complex S_l^odd/even across independent numerical and arbitrary-precision routes
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Same complex-S observable and definition as the accepted V1 selected comparison; 2e-6 is inherited only for this identical observable, not copied to a new quantity.

thresholds.domain: all V3.1 modes with 0<Gamma<=1e-8, comparing finite log(Gamma)
thresholds.observable: log Gamma across independent direct-flux/AP routes
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: New greybody observable budget: 2e-4 in log space corresponds to about 0.02% relative probability and prevents binary64-zero acceptance.

thresholds.domain: all V3.1 modes, normalized by F_in
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Real-potential Wronskian identity from V3-F03; 1e-8 is an observable-level conservation allocation below the S comparison budget.

thresholds.domain: all V3.1 modes with Gamma_flux>=1e-8
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Independent direct horizon-flux versus S-unitarity route; absolute budget avoids inflating relative error near zero.

thresholds.domain: all V3.1 modes with 0<Gamma_flux<1e-8, comparing log values
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Small-Gamma companion to V3T-GAMMA-ROUTES-001; uses the same 2e-4 log budget as the AP comparison.

thresholds.domain: all V3.1 Schwarzschild modes
thresholds.observable: distance of Gamma_flux and Gamma_S outside [0,1]
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Schwarzschild has no superradiance; V3-F04 requires a probability in [0,1]. Small numerical slack is bounded below the route-agreement tolerance.

thresholds.domain: all independently solved odd/even V3.1 mode pairs
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Exact modulus equality from V3-F05; numerical budget matches direct flux-route agreement.

thresholds.domain: all independently solved odd/even V3.1 pairs with |S|>=1e-10
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Exact relative phase from Dolan Eq. (9)/Folacci Eq. (12); 2e-6 rad aligns with the complex-S comparison scale.

thresholds.domain: adjacent 80/120/180 decimal-digit AP ladder values for complex S
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Allocates one quarter of the independent-route complex-S budget to AP-anchor convergence.

thresholds.domain: adjacent 80/120/180 decimal-digit AP ladder values where Gamma>0
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Reserves half of the log-Gamma external-route budget for anchor convergence.

thresholds.domain: adjacent r_in_eps/M values 1e-8, 1e-10, 1e-12 for complex S
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Boundary-systematic allocation for the same complex-S observable; it is not a new radial PASS claim.

thresholds.domain: adjacent r_in_eps/M values where Gamma>0
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Direct small-probability boundary-systematic budget.

thresholds.domain: accepted adjacent r_out multipliers and Jost orders in the V3.1 ladder
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Same S observable as V3T-S-COMPLEX-001; outer-boundary allocation equals its total independent-route budget and must pass separately.

thresholds.domain: accepted adjacent r_out multipliers and Jost orders where Gamma>0
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Small-probability outer-boundary budget, kept separate from complex S.

thresholds.domain: adjacent tolerance pairs in the V3.1 ladder
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Numerical convergence allocation for complex S.

thresholds.domain: adjacent tolerance pairs where Gamma>0
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Numerical convergence allocation for extremely small greybody factors.

thresholds.domain: every V3.2 frequency, adjacent accepted ell_max ladder totals
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: New summed-observable governance budget; not inherited from a radial gate.

thresholds.domain: every V3.2 frequency at the accepted ell_max
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Tail allocation equal to the ell_max stability budget; denominator is max(sigma_abs, M^2) to remain defined near zero.

thresholds.domain: log-log fit on kM=[0.005,0.01,0.02,0.05] with all four points and reported fit uncertainty
thresholds.observable: fitted power of sigma_abs/M^2 versus kM
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Page Eq. (19) predicts power 4. Tolerance 0.10 separates a wrong scaling law from finite-frequency corrections.

thresholds.domain: zero-frequency intercept of sigma_abs/[M^2(kM)^4] from the frozen low-frequency fit
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Primary-source coefficient from Page Eq. (19); 5% includes fit/asymptotic uncertainty but not failed numerical convergence.

thresholds.domain: trapezoidal frequency-window average over kM=[4,6,8,12] compared with 27*pi
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Dolan/Page geometric-optics limit; 8% is a pre-producer asymptotic budget. Pointwise oscillations are diagnostic and cannot fail this field by themselves.

thresholds.domain: external/AP total-absorption anchors listed for V3.2, after both routes pass internal convergence
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Independent summed-observable agreement budget; intentionally looser than mode S but tighter than asymptotic-model tests.

thresholds.domain: theta in [5,175] degrees, adjacent 2/1/0.5 degree grids, excluding analytic zeros via absolute fallback 1e-8 M^2
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: New angular observable convergence allocation.

thresholds.domain: theta in [5,175] degrees, adjacent ell_max=128/256/512 after angle convergence
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Long-range partial-wave sum requires its own cutoff gate; no radial threshold is reused.

thresholds.domain: each stage angle domain, adjacent q=1/2/3 reduced series after ell_max convergence
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Yennie identity and Dolan q=2 practice; a reduction order may accelerate but must not change the physical sum.

thresholds.domain: kM<=0.05 and theta in [10,170] degrees, after all numerical convergence gates
thresholds.observable: M^-2 d sigma/dOmega versus Dolan Eq. (36)
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Dolan leading formula has O(kM) amplitude corrections; 10% is a frozen asymptotic-model budget and is not a numerical tolerance.

thresholds.domain: kM<=0.05, theta in [10,170] degrees, f and g assessed separately away from magnitude<1e-8 M
thresholds.observable: complex f/M and g/M versus Dolan Eqs. (19)--(20), modulo one shared phase per frequency
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Common absolute phase remains PARTIAL; 12% includes O(kM) asymptotic error while retaining ell/parity/helicity phase sensitivity.

thresholds.domain: V3.3 external-backend anchor frequencies/angles after route-specific convergence
thresholds.observable: d sigma/dOmega across independent partial-wave/CAM/direct backends
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Independent backend numerical agreement budget; literature plots alone cannot satisfy it.

thresholds.domain: independent Schwarzschild null-geodesic solve for deflection pi
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Exact-geodesic value reported by Dolan below Eq. (6); this is a geodesic numerical gate, not the Darwin approximation.

thresholds.domain: independent Schwarzschild null-geodesic derivative at theta=pi
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Exact-geodesic value reported by Dolan; derivative extraction is less conditioned than b_g and receives a 1e-4 budget.

thresholds.domain: first off-axis backward ring in theta=[150,180] degrees for kM=[4,6,8,12]
thresholds.observable: numerical first-ring peak angle versus V3-F13 glory predictor
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Semiclassical glory model; 0.75 degree pre-producer asymptotic allowance is separate from the 0.05 degree numerical grid.

thresholds.domain: first-ring FWHM in theta=[150,180] degrees for kM=[4,6,8,12]
thresholds.observable: first-ring FWHM versus V3-F13 glory predictor
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Semiclassical approximation is leading order; 15% is the frozen model-error budget.

thresholds.domain: first-ring peak height for kM=[4,6,8,12] after grid/ell/q convergence
thresholds.observable: first-ring peak d sigma/dOmega versus V3-F13 glory predictor
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Amplitude is most sensitive to neglected semiclassical corrections; 20% is a declared asymptotic budget, not a numerical pass threshold.

thresholds.domain: first-ring peak angle/FWHM/height across adjacent 0.2/0.1/0.05 degree grids and adjacent ell_max ladders
thresholds.observable: glory feature extraction numerical stability, with angle compared after division by one degree
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Numerical uncertainty must remain much smaller than the declared semiclassical-model allowances.

thresholds.domain: V3.4 external/CAM anchor feature triples after route-specific convergence
thresholds.observable: glory peak angle, width, and amplitude across independent backends
thresholds.rationale_source_derivation: Independent high-frequency observable agreement; 2% is tighter than the semiclassical allowance but looser than internal convergence.
